text:
Carla (CS): heads up — ACME reported a morning ramp where their dedicated pool didn't scale quickly enough, they saw ~25% 429s for ~3m during the spike. customer on dedicated-prod-us-west, committed min_replicas=2.
Alex K: can you paste the repro steps / approximate qps pattern?
Carla (CS): they ramped from 5->180 rps over ~60s, steady for 3m. Support repro in staging shows same behavior. Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-12345
Priya S: config excerpt from the customer's deployment:
```
model: xlarge-v1
dedicated:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 40
  scale_policy:
    type: rps
    target_rps_per_replica: 50
  scale_down_delay_sec: 300
  cold_start_warmup_sec: 240
```
Priya S: so target triggers at ~100rps to add replica, but initial 180rps should add ~2-3 replicas. what do the controller logs say?
Dan M: I grabbed the autoscaler logs from the affected cluster around the window:
```
[2026-03-15T09:02:11Z] metrics: rps=175, active_replicas=2
[2026-03-15T09:02:20Z] autoscaler: decision=holdoff backoff=30s reason=recent_scale_event
[2026-03-15T09:02:50Z] attach: enqueue=12 attach_throttle=RATE_LIMIT
[2026-03-15T09:03:05Z] nodeprovision: kicked off 2 nodes, image_pull_backoff=0
[2026-03-15T09:05:30Z] replicas_ready=3 latency=220ms queued=80
```
Dan M: notice the "decision=holdoff" line — autoscaler backoff is preventing immediate successive scale-outs.
Li (SRE): we intentionally have a scaling holdoff to avoid thrash, but holdoff should be adaptive. This looks like a warmpool / attach concurrency mismatch: attach subsystem couldn't attach containers fast enough because warmpool had been recycled overnight.
Alex K: any errors from attach API? could be IAM or registry pull rate limiting.
Dan M: attach logs show intermittent 429 from attach-service: `attach_throttle=RATE_LIMIT` and a spike in attach queue length. No IAM denies.
Priya S: reproduction steps for staging I used (short):
1) start a steady baseline 10rps to pin min_replicas
2) send a linear ramp to 180rps over 60s:
```
for i in {1..60}; do rps=$((i*3)); hey -q $rps -z 60s http://staging-dedicated/repl; sleep 1; done
```
3) observe latency and 429s
Priya S: staging shows same holdoff behavior — autoscaler waits 30s after initial scale then doesn't immediately request more due to attach queue
Li (SRE): short-term mitigation: increase min_replicas for this customer to 5 during peak hours, or bump warmpool size and reduce scale holdoff for that pool. Long-term: make attach backpressure feed into autoscaler so it can request extra headroom proactively.
Alex K: can we add a temporary emergency config change? bump min_replicas to 6 and warmpool to 3 for acme-prod-us-west now? I can push via support-runbook if infra ok.
Li (SRE): I can do the warmpool tweak (low risk). For min_replicas we need account approval from billing ops — cc @billing-ops. Also want to lower scale_holdoff from 30s -> 10s for this pool as a canary.
Carla (CS): I'll message the customer with the temporary increase and see if they want us to schedule it for morning peaks only.
autoscale-bot: [2026-03-15T09:05:30Z] scale_event: started replicas=2 -> desired=4 reason=rps_threshold
Priya S: quick idea — add a prewarm probe at t-5m when schedule indicates expected ramp (customer has predictable traffic spikes). Could integrate with our console schedules.
Dan M: repro note — when we artificially reduced image pull concurrency on staging, the attach queue grew and autoscaler didn't overprovision since it didn't see successful attach events. Root cause = attach-side throttling + static holdoff heuristics.
Li (SRE): action items:
- increase warmpool for acme-prod-us-west (I will do) — DONE (09:18)
- propose autoscaler change: allow one aggressive extra replica if attach queue > 10 (priory: eng-platform) — created ENGPLAT-5342
- temporary min_replicas bump request to billing (Carla)
- follow-up postmortem and new metric: attach_queue_length exported to autoscaler prometheus (Dan)
Carla (CS): assigned INC-12345 -> eng-platform, notified customer: "we're provisioning extra warm instances and will monitor; will follow up with root cause and next steps" :thumbsup:
Alex K: thanks all — keep updates here when warmpool/min_replicas changes land.
Li (SRE): update: warmpool increase propagated, saw reduced attach queue within 4 minutes and 429s dropped to baseline. will keep monitoring for 2h.
Carla (CS): customer confirmed improvement and reduced error rate, keeping ticket open until autoscaler change planned.
